git_not_found: Git isn't installed, or Garam can't find it.
git_too_old: Git {{found}} is too old. Garam needs Git {{required}} or later.
not_a_repository: This folder isn't a Git repository.
bare_repository: This is a bare repository, which has no working files. Choose a repository with a working folder.
destination_not_empty: The destination folder already exists and isn't empty. Choose a different name or location.
remote_not_found: The repository wasn't found. Check the URL, and that you have access to it.
authentication_failed: Git couldn't sign in to the remote. Check your credentials or SSH key.
network_error: Couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection and the URL.
storage_failed: Garam couldn't save its repository list.
nothing_to_commit: There's nothing to commit. Select files to include first.
identity_missing: Git doesn't know who you are yet. Set your name and email.
trash_failed: The files couldn't be moved to the Trash, so nothing was discarded.
watch_failed: Garam can't watch this folder for changes. Changes appear when you return to the window.
save_failed: Couldn't save the file. Check the location and permissions.
invalid_branch_name: That isn't a valid branch name. Avoid spaces and characters like ~ ^ : ? * [ \.
branch_exists: A branch with that name already exists.
branch_not_merged: This branch has commits that aren't merged anywhere else.
local_changes_would_be_overwritten: Your uncommitted changes would be overwritten. Commit or stash them first.
pull_blocked_by_local_changes: Uncommitted changes are in the way of the pull. Commit them first, or stash them for the pull.
merge_conflict: The merge stopped because of conflicts. Resolve the conflicted files, then commit.
unrelated_histories: These branches don't share any history, so Git won't merge them.
rebase_conflict: The rebase stopped because of conflicts. Resolve the conflicted files to continue.
revert_conflict: The revert stopped because of conflicts. Resolve the conflicted files, then commit.
non_fast_forward: The remote has commits you don't have yet. Pull first, then push again.
push_rejected: The remote refused the push. The branch may be protected, or a server hook declined it.
cannot_fast_forward: Your branch and its upstream have both changed, and Git is set to only fast-forward when pulling.
no_upstream: This branch isn't connected to a remote branch yet. Publish it first.
remote_branch_not_found: The remote branch this branch tracks no longer exists. Publish the branch to create it again.
no_remote: That remote doesn't exist in this repository.
detached_head: You aren't on a branch. Switch to a branch first.
conflicts_remain: Some files still have conflicts. Resolve them all before continuing.
nothing_in_progress: There's no merge, rebase, revert or cherry-pick to continue or abort.
unknown: Something went wrong while running Git.
keychain_failed: Couldn't read the account's token from the system keychain. If you're asked whether Garam may use the keychain, choose Always Allow and try again.
github_unreachable: Couldn't reach GitHub. Check your internet connection.
github_unauthorized: GitHub no longer accepts this account's sign-in. Sign in again.
github_login_expired: The code expired before it was approved. Try again.
github_not_found: GitHub couldn't find the repository with this account. The account may lack access, or the organization may not have approved Garam yet.
github_oauth_app_restricted: This organization hasn't approved Garam yet. Ask an organization owner to approve it, or request access from Garam's page in your GitHub settings.
github_sso_required: This organization uses single sign-on. Authorize Garam's access for the organization on GitHub, then try again.
github_rate_limited: Too many requests were sent to GitHub. Try again later.
github_no_account: Choose a GitHub account for this repository first.
cherry_pick_conflict: The cherry-pick stopped because of conflicts. Resolve the conflicted files to continue.
cherry_pick_empty: This branch already has these changes, so there was nothing to cherry-pick.
nothing_to_stash: There are no changes to put aside.
stash_not_found: These stashed changes are gone. They may have been restored or dropped elsewhere.
stash_untracked_exists: Some files in the stashed changes already exist here, so nothing was restored. Move or delete those files, or restore the changes on a new branch.
invalid_tag_name: That isn't a valid tag name. Avoid spaces and characters like ~ ^ : ? * [ \.
tag_exists: A tag with this name already exists.
remote_tag_exists: The remote already has a tag with this name on a different commit. Rename the tag here, or delete the one on the remote first.
head_moved: The last commit changed in the meantime. Check the history and try again.
cannot_squash: These commits can't be squashed. They must follow one another on the current branch, with no merge commit among or after them.
uncommitted_changes: There are uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them first.
cannot_reorder: These commits can't be reordered. They must be the latest on the current branch, with no merge commit among them.
update_check_failed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
update_install_failed: Couldn't install the update. Try again, or download the new version from the releases page.
